description.zh: 给图片写一句文本替代：信息图传达同样的信息，装饰图写空 alt 让读屏跳过，功能图描述动作而非画面。读屏用户、图片加载失败的用户和搜索引擎都靠这句话理解图在说什么。
description.en: A text alternative for every image: informative images convey the same information, decorative images get empty alt so readers skip them, functional images describe the action rather than the pixels. Screen-reader users, users on failed image loads and search engines all lean on this one line.

use_when.zh: 承载信息的图片、图表、插画、二维码
use_when.en: Images that carry information — charts, illustrations, QR codes

use_when.zh: 头像、商品图、文章配图等语义内容
use_when.en: Semantic content — avatars, product shots, article figures

use_when.zh: 图片是链接或按钮的唯一内容时
use_when.en: When an image is the sole content of a link or button

avoid_when.zh: 给装饰性纹理、分隔线写「图片」「image」占位
avoid_when.en: Writing "image" / "图片" for decorative texture or dividers

avoid_when.zh: 把长篇说明塞进 alt（应配 visible caption 或 aria-describedby）
avoid_when.en: Stuffing essays into alt — use a visible caption or aria-describedby

avoid_when.zh: 相邻文字已完整描述时再把同一句念一遍
avoid_when.en: Re-reading text that the adjacent copy already states

disambiguation.zh: alt 文本是图片的文本替代，tooltip 是指针悬停的补充说明——前者服务读屏与图片失效场景，后者只服务看得见的指针用户。
disambiguation.en: Alt text is the image's text alternative; a tooltip is a pointer-hover add-on — the former serves screen readers and failed loads, the latter only sighted pointer users.

note.zh: tooltip 是悬停才出现的补充说明，替代文本是图片本身无障碍必需的文本替身。
note.en: tooltip is hover-only supplementary text; alt text is the image's required accessible stand-in.

note.zh: 传达图片信息本身，如「3 月销量环比上涨 18%」
note.en: Conveys the image's information — e.g. "March sales up 18% month over month"

note.zh: alt="" 让读屏直接跳过，不留噪音
note.en: alt="" so readers skip it without noise

note.zh: 描述动作：「关闭」而不是「灰色叉号图标」
note.en: Describes the action — "Close", not "grey X icon"

notes.zh: 永远给 写 alt 属性；纯装饰用 alt=""（或 role="presentation" + aria-hidden），不要省略属性——省略会让读屏念出文件名。图标按钮用 aria-label 或可见文字，不要依赖图标字体的伪元素文本。图内文字尽量搬到 HTML；复杂图表配 aria-describedby 指向长描述。
notes.en: Always set alt on . Purely decorative images take alt="" (or role="presentation" + aria-hidden) — omitting the attribute makes readers speak the filename. Icon-only buttons get aria-label or visible text, never icon-font pseudo-element text. Keep text in images out of the bitmap when possible; complex charts point aria-describedby at a long description.

basic.zh: 检查并补齐全站图片的替代文本，装饰图标记为可跳过。
basic.en: Audit and fill in alt text for every image, marking decorative ones as skippable.

design.zh: 信息图的 alt 写「信息结论」而不是「画面描述」；装饰图 alt 置空；图标按钮文案说动作；商品图与头像 alt 含关键辨识信息（名称、颜色）。
design.en: Informative alt states the takeaway, not the paint; decorative alt is empty; icon buttons name the action; product and avatar alt carries identifying facts — name, colour.

implementation.zh: 所有 显式写 alt；装饰图 alt=""；
implementation.en: Set alt explicitly on every ; decorative images get alt=""; decorative

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现图片替代文本规范。
先检查现有组件体系和 Design Token，优先复用当前组件。
要求：
- 所有信息图有表达信息结论的 alt
- 装饰图 alt=""，读屏可跳过
- 图标按钮与链接用 aria-label 描述动作
保持现有项目视觉风格。不要新增不必要依赖。
尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。
完成后运行项目现有检查，并列出修改的文件。
agent.en:
Implement an alt-text convention in the current project.
Inspect the existing component system and design tokens first; reuse current components.
Requirements:
- Every informative image has alt that states the takeaway
- Decorative images use alt="" so readers skip them
- Icon buttons and links describe the action via aria-label
Keep the existing visual style. Add no unnecessary dependencies.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
Run the project's existing checks when done and list the modified files.
